title: Red-ink sketch of shallow arc with height arrows; note "Sunsets vs. sunrises spectacular"
description: Torn spiral-notebook page with a red-ink sketch of a long, shallow curved arc, with small vertical arrows above its midpoint labeled "h" and "s" and a letter below. A pencil note to the left reads approximately "Sunsets vs. sunrises" with "spectacular" underlined. The lower portion of the page is torn away.
